mood: Two lights climb toward the chest of something vast, crossing and crossing again like fireworks.

hero.alt: Guinevere and Vexana stand side by side under a storm sky, her two drones up with their red fists and the staff glowing in Vexana's hand; then a vast dark winged shape spreads over the ruined city, two small figures facing it below.

thumb.alt: Guinevere stands ready under a storm sky, one cat-eared drone hovering beside her with its red fists up.

media.alt: A dark winged shape hangs in front of a vast four-pointed tear of violet light above the ruined city, the tear's edges burning bright.
Four faces side by side, the team on the platform, every one of them shouting, ready.
media.credit: Official Guinevere and Vexana interactive drama

media.alt: Streaks of cyan, gold and red light from below meet on the crowned head of a vast winged shape; then a red-gold light and a violet one sweep in from both sides and cross as they dive at it.
media.credit: Official Guinevere and Vexana interactive drama and Re:Link animation
